Been lurking a bit over on reddit and then back over here and I see there's some goings on about the structure voat is to take as far as mods and defaults go. I figure since I've done a little bit of this stuff in the past, I could throw in a few cents worth of ideas since I like voat and all.

The defaults on reddit are far too homogeneous. There's no opportunity for new visitors to see the really quirky things that can happen on reddit because they're sandboxed to lulz and cats. But voat can be different. Here's my idea:

The 'Endorsed by Voat' badge

What if voat had a badge that it would give certain subverses as long as they were in line with the kind of content the voat users and admins wanted to show off to logged out users. This would be kind of a special honor to those subverses- and the badges could be given to far more subs than there are defaults on reddit. This would mean the front page of voat would come from a wider array of subs which would decrease the moderator load on those 20-30 'defaults.'

How would these 'voat endorsed' subverses be chosen? voats of course.

The admins would come to voat with their list of recommendations every month- and voat would also provide a list (let's say each list had 50 subverses to start). The community would rank the admins list and the admins would rank the community's list (from most wanted to least wanted). Then the top 25 in each list would get the 'voat approved' badge. This would would be a monthly thing and the community would be invited to make an event out of it so that the front page would always stay relevant. This would prevent any one subverse from getting a stranglehold on traffic for voat, alleviate overall moderator burden, and still give voat a way to ensure that the content on the front page is business worthy.

Thoughts?
